content:
Sam K: T-minus 25 until the change window. Quick last-minute checklist?
Eve P: All tests passed on staging. Canary cluster warmed.
Ravi M: Note: service-rate limiter bump was deployed earlier; double-checked token buckets. No regressions.
Sam K: Are we keeping the freeze extension rule enabled for 1h post-launch?
Lena G: Recommend 2h for this feature since it touches routing and edge caches.
Eve P: Agree. Requesting approval for 2h silent freeze (no model or routing changes) after launch.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot triggered: pin request accepted. pin id pin-20260321-21. Model: personalizer-v3. Target environment: production.
infra-oncall: infra-oncall: CDN cache invalidation window confirmed. TTLs are paused for the rollout path /v2/personalize.
Ravi M: Rolling canary plan: 1% -> 5% (10m) -> 25% (30m) -> 100% (90m). Abort if error-rate >1% sustained for 5m.
Sam K: Add quality gate: BLEU-like metric drop >3% triggers hold. Eve, can you run the smoke eval after 5m at each step?
Eve P: Will run automated evals. Hooking in eval-runner: `./evals/run.sh --suite launch_smoke --output /tmp/evals`
Lena G: Also watch embedding-generation tail latency; we've seen a drift in sigma during previous runs.
Ravi M: Pre-approved rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback --to personalizer-v2 --route /v2/personalize`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started for route /v2/personalize. step: 1% traffic.
Eve P: Step 1 OK. Eval pass. Latency within expected bounds.
Sam K: Proceed to 5%.
Eve P: 5% applied. Small blip in eval BLEU (-0.8%) but within tolerance.
Lena G: Observability: increasing sampling for traces on this route for 2h.
infra-oncall: infra-oncall: Disk IO spike seen on redis-cache-02 at 00:42; not correlated to canary traffic. We're investigating but not critical.
Ravi M: Advance to 25%.
Eve P: 25% in. Eval shows -1.2% BLEU. Still under 3% threshold.
Sam K: Hold if BLEU crosses -3% or error-rate >1%. No holds so far.
Eve P: 50% now. Metrics still OK.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary progressed to 100% over 80m. Pin pin-20260321-21 remains active.
Lena G: Activating post-launch freeze for 2h as approved.
infra-oncall: infra-oncall: schedule added to monitor for 24h on the route. Alerts for 5xx and latency > 300ms.
Sam K: Release notes draft created: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-21-personalizer. Link to ops checklist in the doc.
Ravi M: Emergency unpin steps shared in runbook. If needed: `deploy-bot unpin pin-20260321-21 --force` then `deploy-bot rollback --to personalizer-v2`.
Eve P: Running one last smoke eval set. All green.
Sam K: Thanks team. Closing thread after freeze lifts. Will open follow-up if infra issue escalates. :white_check_mark:
infra-oncall: infra-oncall: flagged redis investigation to later shift; not blocking.
